evidence.quote: He’s short but not very fat, I would say he is quite slim. He has long, straight, blonde hair. Today he’s wearing a white T-shirt and shorts.

evidence.quote: Jane is wearing a pink blouse.

explanations.text: 例题。Jane is wearing a pink blouse 用现在进行说她正穿着，是现在，填 P。
It might rain 里的 might 表示可能发生的将来，填 F。

evidence.quote: Joanne wants to go to the match.

explanations.text: Joanne wants to go to the match 里的 wants 是现在的愿望，填 P。
They love playing hockey 说的是现在的喜好，填 P。

evidence.quote: Are we going to go out today?

explanations.text: Are we going to go out today 用 going to 说打算，是将来，填 F。
I think he’ll help us 用 will 说将来，填 F。
I’d prefer to have pizza 说的是现在的选择，填 P。
Are you enjoying the party 用现在进行说正在发生的事，填 P。

evidence.quote: I’m meeting Sam at the bus stop.

explanations.text: I’m meeting Sam at the bus stop 用现在进行表示已经约好的将来安排，填 F。

evidence.quote:
Girl: I want to play tennis tomorrow.
Boy: The tennis courts are busy on Saturdays. I’d prefer to play on Sunday.
Girl: I’m going to visit my grandmother on Sunday. She hasn’t been feeling well since Thursday.
Boy: OK, then, but we’ll need to get there early.

explanations.text: 女孩想明天打网球。男孩说周六球场很忙、想改到周日，女孩周日要去看奶奶。男孩随后同意，并说要早点到。周日去不成，周六场地忙，所以按明天打。答案页选图 A。

evidence.quote: Printed links: It’s just started to rain. Fine. It’s only a 5-minute walk to the station.

explanations.text: 印刷页把例题 “Let’s go to the park.” 连到 It’s just started to rain.（拒绝并说明原因）和 Fine. It’s only a 5-minute walk to the station.（同意）。其余六句已由教师说明配给后面三题。原书把带球配给乘火车、把去车站配给公园，意思并不贴切；这里按原书搭配写入，仍待人工确认。

evidence.quote: 1 I would prefer coffee. Yes, that sounds delicious.

explanations.text: 教师说明第 1 组：I would prefer coffee. 是拒绝巧克力蛋糕并改口；Yes, that sounds delicious. 是同意。

evidence.quote: 2 No, let’s drive. Yes, and let’s take a ball.

explanations.text: 教师说明第 2 组：No, let’s drive. 是拒绝；Yes, and let’s take a ball. 是同意。带球和乘火车不贴切，仍保留答案页原文，没有改成更顺的那一句。

evidence.quote: 3 Good idea. She’s really clever. She’s very busy at the moment.

explanations.text: 教师说明第 3 组：Good idea. She’s really clever. 是同意；She’s very busy at the moment. 是拒绝并给出原因。
No, let’s drive. 用 No 拒绝建议，填 D。
I would prefer coffee. 没有接受建议，而是改要咖啡，填 D。教师说明指出，拒绝不一定以 No 开头。
Yes, that sounds delicious. 是同意，填 A。
Good idea. She’s really clever. 是同意，填 A。
Yes, and let’s take a ball. 是同意并补了一句，填 A。
She’s very busy at the moment. 用正忙来拒绝，填 D。
例题。It’s just started to rain. 用下雨作为不去的理由，是拒绝，填 D。
例题。Fine. It’s only a 5-minute walk to the station. 用 Fine 表示同意，填 A。

blocks.text:
Task type: three-option visual multiple choice – listening to identify specific information – two-speaker short conversations – five items
Topic focus: describing people, parts of the home
Training
Tell students that in Part 1 they have to choose the correct picture.

1 Part 1 sometimes includes a question about a person’s appearance. Ask the students to look at the pictures and suggest a few words to describe each man. Tell students to read the words and match each one with the man which it best describes.

2 Tell students they will hear a woman talking about one of the three men. Students listen and answer the question.
Tell students to work in pairs and describe one of the pictures. When their description is finished, the partner guesses which of the men was described.

3 Ask students to look at the pictures and say which rooms they can see. Tell students to label the pictures with the words from the box.
A2 Key candidates often misspell the words sitting room, living room and kitchen as seating room, leaving room and kichen. Revise the spellings of rooms in the house.

4 Tell students that in Part 1 they will often need to understand prepositions, e.g. on and under.
Students read the sentences and put a tick or cross next to each of them.
Extension
Ask students to draw a floor plan of a room in their house. Tell students to work in pairs and, without showing their picture to their partner, describe what there is and where it is.
A2 Key candidates often make mistakes using the present continuous. Remind them that it is used to talk about both present and future time. In the future, it is used for arrangements, e.g. I’m meeting my friend later.

5 In this exercise, students will hear examples of different ways to talk about the future. Review the different ways to talk about the future before playing the recording.
Students listen to the sentences and write P (present) or F (future).
A2 Key candidates often think will is the only future form. Remind them that will + verb is only one way to talk about the future.
Extension
Ask students to look at the audioscript and highlight different ways of talking about the future (might + verb, want to + verb, going to + verb, I think ... will + verb, ’d prefer to + verb, present continuous). They do not need to practise or produce all of these. However, they need to be aware that there is more than one way of talking about the future.
6 Play the recording and tell students to answer the question.

7 Explain that all four sentences are suggestions and that we can reply to suggestions with Yes or No. Tell students that if we say No to a suggestion, we usually give a reason. Give an example.
Ask students to do the exercise and tell them that there is one Yes reply and one No reply for each suggestion.
1 I would prefer coffee. Yes, that sounds delicious.
2 No, let’s drive. Yes, and let’s take a ball.
3 Good idea. She’s really clever. She’s very busy at the moment.

8 Tell students to look at the replies in Exercise 7 and write A or D. Point out that not all the replies start with Yes or No.
Used to agree (A): Yes, that sounds delicious. Good idea. She’s really clever. Yes, and let’s take a ball.
Used to disagree (D): No, let’s drive. I would prefer coffee. She’s very busy at the moment.
9 Tell students to listen to the recording and focus on the suggestion and response carefully.
